family.selection: All 313 retained prime tiles in the pinned campaign pool.

nonclaims: A bounded null is not evidence that no finite cover exists.
Passing sampled points is not an exact cover and is not a Verification.
This engineering iteration is not a fresh context-isolated scientific episode.
A candidate changes no Standing unless the frozen exact verifier passes and a human Decision accepts it.

preflight.discarded_method: An exact-cell parallel-tree prototype was discarded before retention after forcing all six low-order tiles generated more than 100000 cells almost immediately.
preflight.disclosure: A 256-point smoke test of the implementation was completed before freezing this declaration. Its greedy initial assignment covered the registered sample and 844 of 1000 independent probe points. The smoke output is not retained scientific evidence.

search.algorithm: Deterministic-seed full-pool min-conflicts over sampled integer lattice points, followed by independent deterministic probe batches and counterexample addition.
search.stopping_rule: Stop at the first assignment covering an entire registered sample and its 50000-point independent probe batch, local-search exhaustion, six completed iterations, or 300 wall seconds. Any sampled candidate must then pass the separately frozen exact affine verifier before it can be submitted.
